notes: Original git STACK.md is the requirements source. This is a new schematic completion design and does not claim bench or manufacturing validation.
K1_ON/K2_ON replace incorrect draft K1_DRV/K2_DRV labels. Every unknown module contact uses a functional named interface; no GPx(TBD) nets are used.

Canonical additions agreed across sheets: PICO_OFF, PICO_DISP_EN, PWR_BUTTON, CHG_INHIBIT, E1_BAT_ADC. E1 owns the battery ADC divider and button diode to Pololu A; E3 owns the switch and Q6A power-key OR.
MCP enable pulldowns and RF input 100k/1k/100pF filters belong to E2/E4/E5 recipient sheets. E3 owns nineteen input pullups to switched 3V3_Q6A.
The DNP 10k I2C2 pullup pair is not populated by default. Q6A-side pullups are already present onboard; TCA9517 cable buffer and its remote-side pullups belong to E5.
Pack internal named-pad wiring appears as U309/U314. E5 owns GX16-4, input Schottky and both endpoint TVS arrays; E5_IMU_VIN is the protected 5V pack supply.

Pico GP17 physical22 is now E3_MCP_RESET_ASSERT through R393100ohm to Q3062N7002 gate, with R394100k gate-source pulldown and R3951k GPIO-side pullup toPico3V3. Q306 drain joins physical pin18 of allthree internal MCPs. Three existing10k pullups are to3V3_Q6A only. No free PicoGPIO remains.

This change supplies the missing hardware actuator for a future Pico heartbeat watchdog. It is not proof of firmware implementation or independent protection against every simultaneous Pico/Linux failure. Commissioning requires the explicit boot/hang/re-arm fault-injection gate.

With Pico supply present, powered GPIO reset/highimpedance defaults to asserting the shared MCP reset via R395; a functioning future firmware must sink GP17 low for release. Without the required firmware the expander-controlled branches remain disabled rather than being commissioned.
Only one QUP owner per engine. UART6 uses 16/18, debug console uses 8/10; I2C2 27/28. No safety enable uses Q6A GPIO directly.
Header3V3 and Pico3V3 are different rails; never join. UM3304 paths are short, <50pF; UART7/PPS wiring <=20cm.
GPIO96 exclusive pps-gpio, GP97/98/100 reserved for service SWD/RUN; disable conflicting MI2S audio nodes.

notes: VSYS receives LAB5 through a Schottky diode. Module VBUS is reserved for USB programming or fallback H1. Never bridge VBUS to LAB5; connect USB only with the main switch on or LAB5 isolated.
Remove factory R7 before fitting the external 200 ohm ADC_VREF feed and LM4040C30. Battery ADC divider belongs to E1. ADC inputs must remain below the 3.0V reference.
Before Q6A 3V3 is present, put UART TX, SAFE_BOOT and service outputs in high impedance. This schematic relies on verified firmware sequencing; it does not claim hardware isolation.

All26 exposed GPIOs are assigned: GP17 physical22 now drives the MCP hardware-reset actuator, not brightness. No free Pico GPIO remains. GP23/24/25/29 are module internal and allthree external ADCs are assigned.

Required firmware behavior, not implemented firmware: assert GP17 high early at boot; maintain or assert it on missing/invalid UART heartbeat or unsafe shutdown; hold until an explicit qualified recovery/re-arm sequence. Program safe OLAT=0 and IOCON.ODR/MIRROR before re-enabling outputs and interrupts.

A sustained low on common MCP RESET makes allinternal expander output drivers high-impedance. Recipient pulldowns then disable their power branches, select HMC00 and turn relays off. It also resets allMCP fault history, which software must log before intentional reset where possible.
Brightness remains DDC/CI or a separately documented future KEY interface through an available MCP GPIO. GP17 is committed to watchdog reset.

components.description: Commercial module, functional pad names from maker documentation. Factory regulator, level shifting, decoupling and bias resistors remain on module.

PS1 straps high. PS0/WAKE is pulled high through 1k (overrides the module factory10k pulldown) and connected to Zero GP8: keep it high throughout reset and first INT, then pulse low to wake the BNO for host-initiated SPI as required by the CEVA datasheet.

notes: Do not fit10k here: together with the factory10k pulldown it would produce half-rail and invalid SPI strap. 1k gives about3.0V high at3.3V supply, then GP8 drives the wake pulse low.

components.description: Open-drain pull-down for the shared active-low reset of all three internal MCP23017 expanders. Gate is driven only by Pico GP17.
notes: Physical SOT23 pins:1gate,2source,3drain. No Pico3V3 DC connection to Q6A3V3: the MOS gate is insulated. Drain pullups are only to switched3V3_Q6A.

GP17 high or highimpedance while Pico3V3 is present asserts RESET low via R395. Working firmware must actively hold GP17 low to release reset. R394100k gate-source pulldown turns Q306 off only when Pico supply is absent; complete loss ofPico power is not an independently covered fault.
The three existing10k reset pullups remain in parallel, equivalent3.33k. Sink current is about0.99mA at3.3V. Scope verification must show RESET_N<0.2VDD when asserted and>0.8VDD when released.

components.description: Pullup on the GPIO side of gate series resistor: powered Pico reset/highimpedance asserts MCPreset; normal firmware actively sinks GP17 low to release it.
notes: About3.3mA static current is sunk by GP17 in normal release state. R393 has no static voltage-divider drop when GP17 actively low because the pullup is on its GPIO side.
The1k pullup overrides weak RP2040 pad pulldowns during reset. Verify gate high and RESETlow over actual supply ramp, brownout andtemperature.

open_items.description: Brightness control requires confirmed DDC/CI support or an exact Wisecoco KEY/Backlight interface. Pico GP17 is now reserved for MCP watchdog reset and unavailable for brightness.
open_items.resolve: Demonstrate ddcutil brightness through the specified RA620 link, or obtain exact KEY/Backlight revision pinout and design a new interface using a free MCPGPIO if suitable. Verify thermal dimming; do not reuse PicoGP17.

open_items.description: UM3304 UART7/PPS/SWD cable capacitance and power-off behavior cannot be proven by ERC.
open_items.resolve: Check <=20cm wiring, UART7 loopback, boot glitches and absence of Q6A backfeed with Pico on/Q6A off. Verify TX high-impedance sequencing or add hardware isolation.

open_items.description: Shared MCP interrupt requires open-drain configuration before interrupts are enabled, plus measured I2C rise time and VOL.
open_items.resolve: Set ODR=1 and MIRROR=1 first. Validate 100kHz, rise <=1000ns, 1e6 reads under load, 20 cold/20 warm boots, and 10us FAULT capture.

open_items.description: BOM candidate Semiware MF52A103F3950 is selected for both NTCs; purchased-lot curve, attachment, lag and installed calibration remain unqualified.
open_items.resolve: Verify10k+/-1% at25C and manufacturerB25/50=3950+/-1%; use exactmakerRTtable. Fit insulated bead/strainrelief on panel spreader and frame, check25/60/68C against reference thermometer, qualify lag and open/short/stale fail-safe behavior. Remain inside-20..120C sensorrange.

open_items.description: Battery ADC shutdown accuracy must be calibrated. Divider/reference initial tolerances can contribute about+/-0.28V near12.9V; nominal ADC code does not establish12.9+/-0.1V cutoff.
open_items.resolve: Calibrate gain/offset against a calibrated voltmeter at two pack-equivalent voltages such as12.6V and16.4V; cross-checkINA228. Independently verify physical12.9V software cutoff within+/-0.1V, including5s dwell, at12.8/12.9/13.0V across specifiedtemperature and load states. Store calibratedcoefficients with revision/CRC. No commissioningpassuntilmet; hardwareAON UVsupervisor remains independentbackup.

Hold resetlow>=1us (projectguard100ms minimum,normallylatcheduntilqualifiedrecovery). ActivelysinkGP17LOWonlyfornormalrelease; verifyGPIOsink~3.3mA. ScopeRESET<0.2VDDasserted/>0.8VDDreleased; proveinternalENlow,HMC00,relaysofffrominitialENhighuponLinuxkill/UARThang. Test20cold/20warmboots,PicoGPIOreset/brownout,andQ6Aoff/Picoonwithoutbackfeed.
